spans.text: The Sanctifiers were willing to help? Isn't that a good thing?

units.rawText: I mean, normal agents can't move around outside their sectors, right?
units.displayText: I mean, normal agents can't move around outside their sectors, right?

spans.text: I mean, normal agents can't move around outside their sectors, right?

units.rawText: I never want to see a Sanctifier again, especially HER. She's still trying to ask about Turing.
units.displayText: I never want to see a Sanctifier again, especially HER. She's still trying to ask about Turing.

spans.text: I never want to see a Sanctifier again, especially HER. She's still trying to ask about Turing.

units.rawText: Hannah takes a deep breath and calms back down.
units.displayText: Hannah takes a deep breath and calms back down.

spans.text: Hannah takes a deep breath and calms back down.

units.rawText: In any case, we are completely at odds with the Sanctifiers now. There is no way I'd ever ask them for help.
units.displayText: In any case, we are completely at odds with the Sanctifiers now. There is no way I'd ever ask them for help.

spans.text: In any case, we are completely at odds with the Sanctifiers now. There is no way I'd ever ask them for help.

units.rawText: Besides, considering we have a mysterious virus on the loose, the less foreign factors involved, the better.
units.displayText: Besides, considering we have a mysterious virus on the loose, the less foreign factors involved, the better.

spans.text: Besides, considering we have a mysterious virus on the loose, the less foreign factors involved, the better.

units.rawText: That's true.
units.displayText: That's true.

spans.text: That's true.

units.rawText: Still, something's not right. If the railgun were working according to the specs you gave me, there's no way the Entropics could have gotten in, no matter how many of them there were.
units.displayText: Still, something's not right. If the railgun were working according to the specs you gave me, there's no way the Entropics could have gotten in, no matter how many of them there were.

spans.text: Still, something's not right. If the railgun were working according to the specs you gave me, there's no way the Entropics could have gotten in, no matter how many of them there were.

units.rawText: We were ambushed. The Entropics avoided our defenses and targeted our operand supply lines.
units.displayText: We were ambushed. The Entropics avoided our defenses and targeted our operand supply lines.

spans.text: We were ambushed. The Entropics avoided our defenses and targeted our operand supply lines.

units.rawText: The sector's defenses were paralyzed before I even got reports about it.
units.displayText: The sector's defenses were paralyzed before I even got reports about it.

spans.text: The sector's defenses were paralyzed before I even got reports about it.

units.rawText: Was it the work of that Odile? She really is a sneaky one...
units.displayText: Was it the work of that Odile? She really is a sneaky one...

spans.text: Was it the work of that Odile? She really is a sneaky one...

units.rawText: Still, there's one thing I don't understand. If there really was a mastermind behind this, then why wouldn't these viruses exert their efforts on a sector like Cyclopes instead of focusing their efforts on researchers like us?
units.displayText: Still, there's one thing I don't understand. If there really was a mastermind behind this, then why wouldn't these viruses exert their efforts on a sector like Cyclopes instead of focusing their efforts on researchers like us?

spans.text: Still, there's one thing I don't understand. If there really was a mastermind behind this, then why wouldn't these viruses exert their efforts on a sector like Cyclopes instead of focusing their efforts on researchers like us?

units.rawText: Could it be that they were trying to take one sector to open a beachhead?
units.displayText: Could it be that they were trying to take one sector to open a beachhead?

spans.text: Could it be that they were trying to take one sector to open a beachhead?

units.rawText: That way, they could use Rossum as a staging area to attack other places.
units.displayText: That way, they could use Rossum as a staging area to attack other places.

spans.text: That way, they could use Rossum as a staging area to attack other places.

units.rawText: ...I'm sorry, it's my fault for not properly managing the Rossum Sector.
units.displayText: ...I'm sorry, it's my fault for not properly managing the Rossum Sector.

spans.text: ...I'm sorry, it's my fault for not properly managing the Rossum Sector.

units.rawText: Ah, I'm not blaming you. This sort of thing happened to the Oasis too, and we took a lot of damage from them.
units.displayText: Ah, I'm not blaming you. This sort of thing happened to the Oasis too, and we took a lot of damage from them.

spans.text: Ah, I'm not blaming you. This sort of thing happened to the Oasis too, and we took a lot of damage from them.

units.rawText: Still, with us around, it won't happen again! Let's start that cannon up and wipe out those Entropics outside!
units.displayText: Still, with us around, it won't happen again! Let's start that cannon up and wipe out those Entropics outside!

spans.text: Still, with us around, it won't happen again! Let's start that cannon up and wipe out those Entropics outside!

units.rawText: Yup. Once Turing decompresses the operands, I'll activate the cannon.
units.displayText: Yup. Once Turing decompresses the operands, I'll activate the cannon.

spans.text: Yup. Once Turing decompresses the operands, I'll activate the cannon.

units.rawText: A glimmer of confidence spreads across Hannah's face.
units.displayText: A glimmer of confidence spreads across Hannah's face.

spans.text: A glimmer of confidence spreads across Hannah's face.

units.rawText: Since the Professor has lured the bulk of the Entropics away, our first shot once the cannon is fully charged will be used to help out the Professor. Just send me the coordinates of anything you want blasted.
units.displayText: Since the Professor has lured the bulk of the Entropics away, our first shot once the cannon is fully charged will be used to help out the Professor. Just send me the coordinates of anything you want blasted.

spans.text: Since the Professor has lured the bulk of the Entropics away, our first shot once the cannon is fully charged will be used to help out the Professor. Just send me the coordinates of anything you want blasted.

units.rawText: Alright, let's do this!
units.displayText: Alright, let's do this!

spans.text: Alright, let's do this!

units.rawText: But before that, could I trouble you and your team to help keep an eye on the area around the Admin Center?
units.displayText: But before that, could I trouble you and your team to help keep an eye on the area around the Admin Center?

spans.text: But before that, could I trouble you and your team to help keep an eye on the area around the Admin Center?

units.rawText: I heard that the Entropics were moving as a whole just now, so I'm worried a High-Order Entropic may have assumed control of them and used them to do something.
units.displayText: I heard that the Entropics were moving as a whole just now, so I'm worried a High-Order Entropic may have assumed control of them and used them to do something.

spans.text: I heard that the Entropics were moving as a whole just now, so I'm worried a High-Order Entropic may have assumed control of them and used them to do something.

units.rawText: Can do. Where's the nearest lookout point?
units.displayText: Can do. Where's the nearest lookout point?

spans.text: Can do. Where's the nearest lookout point?

units.rawText: One moment please, I'll put you through.
units.displayText: One moment please, I'll put you through.

spans.text: One moment please, I'll put you through.

units.rawText: Miss Hannah, is something the matter?
units.displayText: Miss Hannah, is something the matter?

spans.text: Miss Hannah, is something the matter?

units.rawText: I need a report on the Entropics' movements. Our allies will be heading over to assist you.
units.displayText: I need a report on the Entropics' movements. Our allies will be heading over to assist you.

spans.text: I need a report on the Entropics' movements. Our allies will be heading over to assist you.

units.rawText: Understood. We detected large quantities of [Splashers] and [Filthbelchers] moving toward the ruins of Labs No. 4 and 7.
units.displayText: Understood. We detected large quantities of [Splashers] and [Filthbelchers] moving toward the ruins of Labs No. 4 and 7.

spans.text: Understood. We detected large quantities of [Splashers] and [Filthbelchers] moving toward the ruins of Labs No. 4 and 7.

units.rawText: 4 and 7? Those are the tallest buildings nearby...
units.displayText: 4 and 7? Those are the tallest buildings nearby...

spans.text: 4 and 7? Those are the tallest buildings nearby...

units.rawText: ...Oh no!
units.displayText: ...Oh no!

spans.text: ...Oh no!

units.rawText: Sol? What's wrong?
units.displayText: Sol? What's wrong?

spans.text: Sol? What's wrong?

units.rawText: Think about it, putting Snipers on high-ground—That must be what the commander of the Entropics is trying to do!
units.displayText: Think about it, putting Snipers on high-ground—That must be what the commander of the Entropics is trying to do!

spans.text: Think about it, putting Snipers on high-ground—That must be what the commander of the Entropics is trying to do!

units.rawText: If we set up anti-air defenses now—
units.displayText: If we set up anti-air defenses now—

spans.text: If we set up anti-air defenses now—

units.rawText: Boom!
units.displayText: Boom!

spans.text: Boom!

units.rawText: Before Croque can finish, the wall behind her suddenly collapses under a tremendous impact.
units.displayText: Before Croque can finish, the wall behind her suddenly collapses under a tremendous impact.

spans.text: Before Croque can finish, the wall behind her suddenly collapses under a tremendous impact.

units.rawText: It's too late!
units.displayText: It's too late!

spans.text: It's too late!

units.rawText: Hannah, get down!
units.displayText: Hannah, get down!

spans.text: Hannah, get down!

units.rawText: Okay!
units.displayText: Okay!

spans.text: Okay!

units.rawText: Hannah panics for a moment but then calms herself down quickly.
units.displayText: Hannah panics for a moment but then calms herself down quickly.

spans.text: Hannah panics for a moment but then calms herself down quickly.

units.rawText: Recon team, report!
units.displayText: Recon team, report!

spans.text: Recon team, report!

units.rawText: Miss Hannah! We've spotted Mid-Order Entropics directing fire against the Admin Center!
units.displayText: Miss Hannah! We've spotted Mid-Order Entropics directing fire against the Admin Center!

spans.text: Miss Hannah! We've spotted Mid-Order Entropics directing fire against the Admin Center!

units.rawText: We're also picking up major structural damage to the Admin Center. At this rate...
units.displayText: We're also picking up major structural damage to the Admin Center. At this rate...

spans.text: We're also picking up major structural damage to the Admin Center. At this rate...

units.rawText: Boom!
units.displayText: Boom!

spans.text: Boom!

units.rawText: The agent doesn't even manage to finish her sentence before another round of bombardment hits them. The exterior of the surface begins to crumble amidst violent shaking, and purple fluid begins seeping in through the cracks in the structure.
units.displayText: The agent doesn't even manage to finish her sentence before another round of bombardment hits them. The exterior of the surface begins to crumble amidst violent shaking, and purple fluid begins seeping in through the cracks in the structure.

spans.text: The agent doesn't even manage to finish her sentence before another round of bombardment hits them. The exterior of the surface begins to crumble amidst violent shaking, and purple fluid begins seeping in through the cracks in the structure.

units.rawText: My Dirac!
units.displayText: My Dirac!

spans.text: My Dirac!

units.rawText: They're planning to blow up the entire Admin Center!
units.displayText: They're planning to blow up the entire Admin Center!

spans.text: They're planning to blow up the entire Admin Center!

units.rawText: That shot from just now must have gotten the attention of a High-Order Entropic, so they're attacking the Admin Center, which was sending signals just now...
units.displayText: That shot from just now must have gotten the attention of a High-Order Entropic, so they're attacking the Admin Center, which was sending signals just now...

spans.text: That shot from just now must have gotten the attention of a High-Order Entropic, so they're attacking the Admin Center, which was sending signals just now...

units.rawText: We don't have time to worry about that. Vanguard team, go protect the Rossum Sector residents!
units.displayText: We don't have time to worry about that. Vanguard team, go protect the Rossum Sector residents!

spans.text: We don't have time to worry about that. Vanguard team, go protect the Rossum Sector residents!

units.rawText: There are still a lot of researchers in the Admin Center, and there's Turing too. None of them can fight...
units.displayText: There are still a lot of researchers in the Admin Center, and there's Turing too. None of them can fight...

spans.text: There are still a lot of researchers in the Admin Center, and there's Turing too. None of them can fight...

units.rawText: We'll send people to take care of them. This place should be able to hold out for a while, right?
units.displayText: We'll send people to take care of them. This place should be able to hold out for a while, right?

spans.text: We'll send people to take care of them. This place should be able to hold out for a while, right?

units.rawText: A few minutes should be fine...
units.displayText: A few minutes should be fine...

units.rawText: Got that? Now move!
units.displayText: Got that? Now move!

spans.text: Got that? Now move!

units.rawText: Yes, ma'am!
units.displayText: Yes, ma'am!

spans.text: Yes, ma'am!

units.rawText: As for us—Croque, we need to take out the enemy's active shooters!
units.displayText: As for us—Croque, we need to take out the enemy's active shooters!

spans.text: As for us—Croque, we need to take out the enemy's active shooters!
